submitted.rationale: All measured EQEs are at noise level (~1e-4 %). This fits 2.1 eV photons sitting below the band gaps of most Bi–Sb–O phases. MEGNet predicts ~2.3 eV for Bi3SbO7 and ~3.1 eV for BiSbO4; Bi2O3 is ~2.8 eV. Index 9 (Sb 0.149) gave the highest value, 0.00023 %, in the Bi-rich region. Bi-rich mixtures (Bi2O3 plus possibly the sillenite phase, predicted gap 1.68 eV, or Bi3SbO7) are the most likely to absorb sub-2.1 eV light.

rejected.reason: EQE 0.00009%. XRD matches alpha-Bi2O3 (0.72) and Bi3SbO7 (0.66), not the sillenite phase (0.35).
EQE 0.00006%. The Sb-rich side is dominated by the wide-gap BiSbO4 and Sb oxides.
